content.short: Modulo-p is a specialized development crew bringing Zero-Knowledge tech to Cardano for privacy and scalability.
content.description: Modulo-p is a development team focused on integrating Zero-Knowledge (ZK) technology into the Cardano blockchain ecosystem. By leveraging advanced cryptography, the crew builds tools and solutions that enable a wide range of novel use cases, particularly in the areas of privacy-preserving transactions and layer-2 scalability. Modulo-p aims to empower projects and communities by extending the current capabilities of the Cardano protocol, providing the infrastructure needed for secure interactions. Their work is a vital contribution to the long-term technical evolution of the network.
content.meta: Modulo-p is a Cardano development crew focused on Zero-Knowledge tech, privacy, and scalability. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
